description: Selected real TradingBotHQ historical aggregate results, transcribed from completed private reports and primary decision records. Public scripts reconstruct the presentation, not private backtests.

units.total_r: sum of normalized planned initial-risk outcomes
units.pf_r: positive R sum divided by absolute negative R sum
units.maxdd_r: maximum ordered closed-trade drawdown in R
units.estimate: N1 percentage points; N2 ATR (see per-record limitations)

records.source_record: H004 matched event study final analysis
records.limitations: Estimate and interval in percentage points of continuation probability; day-cluster 95% interval. Association, not causal proof or executable profitability.
